title: A heritable swim parameter for the Marangoni rods: three surfactant kinds (mar 20/40/60) copied by majority-feedback production keep their kind through fission (96-98% of daughters, kind changes on living rods only at mutations) and set swim speed (Spearman +0.52, p<1e-4) and per-cycle distance (median D 0.85 vs 1.48, p 0.01); the identical-event twin shows no kind effect; the 3-length share stays ~5% in every kind
summary: Built the three-kind ladder of Q:marangoni-heritable-ladder on c34's Marangoni rods: surfactant kinds with Marangoni coefficients 20, 40, 60, majority-feedback production, in-run mutation to a neighbouring kind (1e-3 per body per frame, RNG seeded by seed and frame only), and the p 0.10 + REDIST turnover; identical-event twin with every kind at 40. Seeds 100 and 101, T=2000. Kinds breed true: 18 of 20 kind changes on living rods coincide with logged mutations, 4 of 201 daughters are off-kind, 3 of 4 mutant lineages that divided keep the new kind (one through 2 divisions). Kind sets swimming: pooled path speed 0.153/0.216/0.252 and median D 0.85/1.39/1.48 rod lengths for mar 20/40/60 (k2 vs k0 p 0.010), none in the twin (p 0.79). The per-seed D gap is 0.62 and 0.25 (seed 101 has 6 dividing rods per extreme kind), and rods swimming 3 lengths stay ~5% in every kind. Kind shares follow founder luck; no consistent favoured kind under uniform turnover.

finding.operator: three heritable surfactant kinds with graded Marangoni coefficients, copied by majority-feedback production, in-run neighbour mutation, trait-blind turnover
finding.control: identical-event twin (all kinds mar 40, same seeds, mutation and dilution streams), seeds 100 and 101
finding.result: ladder: Spearman(kind, path speed) +0.52 p<1e-4, k2 vs k0 D p 0.010 (median 1.48 vs 0.85); twin: -0.20, p 0.79; kind changes off mutation 1+1 of 19; off-kind daughters 2/99, 2/102 (twin 6/101, 4/101); D>=3 ~5% in every kind
